voice.channel: Voice channel the bot joins. Reset this setting to disconnect.

automod.adExemptChannels: Channels where external links are allowed. The upload permission applies in every channel.
automod.profanityWords: Separate blocked words and phrases with commas. Leave blank to clear the list.
automod.exemptRoles: Select roles that are exempt from all automatic moderation filters.

items.prefix: Text that starts a command, for example !
items.language: Language the bot uses in this server

levels.cooldownSeconds: Seconds between two XP gains of one member
levels.channel: Channel for level up cards. If empty, the bot replies where the member leveled up

mute.sessionSeconds: Seconds the mute panel waits for a choice before it cancels

purge.maxAmount: Most messages one purge command can delete

ban.sessionSeconds: Seconds the ban panel waits for a choice before it cancels

autorole.roles: Roles given automatically to members who join (bots are skipped)

guildtag.roles: Roles given to members who wear the server tag
guildtag.removeRoles: Take the roles back when the tag is removed
guildtag.logChannel: Channel for logs when someone takes or removes the tag

moderation.logChannel: Channel where moderation actions (ban, mute, purge) are logged

welcome.channel: Channel where new members are welcomed with a card (empty = off)
